name: Camp Wicosuta
description_short: Overnight summer camp for girls in Hebron, NH, running since 1920, with campers grouped by grade from 1st through 9th grade. It offers two 3½-week sessions and a 2-week Explorers session for younger first-time campers.
activities: Private lessons in tennis, soccer and gymnastics (optional, extra cost)
refund_policy_summary: $1,500 deposit with enrollment, which includes a $200 non-refundable application fee. $3,000 is due Jan 31, 2027, and the rest is due Apr 1, 2027. Without CAP: everything except the $200 fee is refundable until Jan 31, 2027. After that the cancellation fee is $1,500 (Feb 1–Mar 16), $2,000 (Mar 17–Apr 30), or $3,500 (May 1–31), and nothing is refunded after June 1. With the optional Camper Assurance Program (CAP), you can cancel for any reason before camp starts and get money back as a refund or a credit, depending on the date. CAP must be bought at enrollment, by Mar 16, 2027 at the latest. Cancellations must be in writing.

warnings: The $200 early-enrollment credit ended 10/1/26, which is before today (2026-10-13).
The 1st–9th grade range comes from the site's grade-group menu (Oski–Totem), not from the rates section.
Explorers grades are given as 'campers completing grades 1-3' / '1-4', so they probably mean the school year that just ended before camp.
The full sessions and the Explorers sessions have different tuition-includes lists. Explorers bus service is listed as transportation 'to camp' only, and optional phone calls are not mentioned.
Sibling credit: $300 for each additional child.
